name:          content
summary:       allows sharing code and data with other snaps
documentation: https://snapcraft.io/docs/content-interface
plugs:
  - firefox:gnome-42-2204:
      content:          gnome-42-2204
      default-provider: gnome-42-2204
      target:           $SNAP/gnome-platform
  - myna:backend:
      content: inference-provider
      target:  $SNAP_DATA/backend
slots:
  - gnome-42-2204:gnome-42-2204:
      content: gnome-42-2204
      read:
        - /
  - myna-parakeet:provider:
      content: inference-provider
      source:
        write:
          - $SNAP_COMMON/share/provider
  - myna-whisper:provider:
      content: inference-provider
      source:
        write:
          - $SNAP_COMMON/share/provider
